title: ML workspace of a department
description: Turns on ML for one department: one Azure ML workspace, shared by all its ML use cases. File name: registry/ml_workspaces/<department>.yaml. The platform's Terraform reads it and calls the ml-workspace module.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file was written for. Only 1.x is supported.

department.description: Department id, e.g. manufacturing. Must match the file name.

resource_group.description: Existing resource group the workspace is created in.

owner.description: Who is responsible for the workspace (usually the platform team).

gpu.description: true = also create a GPU cluster. Needs GPU quota from Microsoft first.

cpu_max_nodes.description: Most CPU machines that may run at once (the cluster always scales back to 0).
